wire.t: Steelers 27, Broncos 5 on Black Friday. Mason Rudolph, starting two days after Pittsburgh released Aaron Rodgers, threw for 142 yards and a 22-yard touchdown to DK Metcalf. Metcalf scored 11.1 for Hold My DK; Rudolph scored 11.68 on the Hold My DK bench while Patrick Mahomes started and scored 5.66.
Bo Nix went 22 of 40 for 169 yards with two interceptions and a lost fumble, which T.J. Watt recovered in the end zone. Nix scored 1.96 for OBJAY, which still leads Asian Jim 36.26 to 15.90.

Rest of the Black Friday damage: Jaylen Waddle 9.3 and Pat Freiermuth 1.1 for Jefferson’s Reserve, Jonah Coleman 12.7 for Kraft for Cash, Rico Dowdle 7.9 and Courtland Sutton 0.9 for Bourbon Lover. Jefferson’s Reserve trails I Chase Brown Kids 33.30 to 10.40.

Justin Herbert is out Sunday against New England, still in concussion protocol; DJ Uiagalelei makes his first career start. Herbert is still in the Kraft for Cash lineup as of this morning. Bryce Young, who plays Monday night, is on the Kraft for Cash bench.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) is off Seattle's final injury report and expected to play at San Francisco. He's on the Asian Jim bench; Malachi Fields and Malik Washington are starting.

Brock Purdy is out with an ankle injury and Mac Jones is expected to start for San Francisco. Catfan94 added Mac Jones Friday evening and dropped Savion Williams, so the 10‑1 team now has five quarterbacks.
Parker Washington is out with a shoulder injury (AC joint) and is still in the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte lineup. Devaughn Vele is on the bench. Bill_Buttlicker has until 1 PM Sunday.
Aaron Rodgers, released by Pittsburgh this week, is still on the Hold My DK roster with no NFL team. Asian Jim is still starting Daniel Jones, also without a team, with Kyler Murray on the bench.

stories.title: Three Sunday lineups have holes in them, and the 6‑5 teams are both losing
stories.dek: Justin Herbert is out and still starting. Jaxon Smith-Njigba is cleared and still sitting. Parker Washington is out and still in mine. Fix it.
body: Black Friday is done and the scoreboard is ugly for the bubble. The Champ trails Hold My DK 48.96 to 22.22 after DK Metcalf scored 11.1 in Pittsburgh. Jefferson’s Reserve got 9.3 from Jaylen Waddle and 1.1 from Pat Freiermuth and trails I Chase Brown Kids 33.30 to 10.40. Both are 6‑5. Six teams make it, playoffs start Week 15, and there are three weeks left including this one.

Now the lineup problems. Kraft for Cash still has Justin Herbert at quarterback, and he's out Sunday in concussion protocol. That's not a dumb start, it's a stale one: the news came Friday. Bryce Young is on the Kraft for Cash bench, averages 21.21 this season and plays Monday night. Even with the swap, my numbers have Catfan94’s Farm Team up about 42.81 on the remaining averages. Without it, 64.02.

Asian Jim is the big one. Daniel Jones, who doesn't have an NFL team, is still starting. Kyler Murray is on the bench with no injury designation on Sleeper. Jaxon Smith-Njigba came off Seattle's final injury report Friday and is on the bench too, behind Malachi Fields. Lineup as is: Asian Jim by about 3.15. Swap in Murray: 17.75. Swap in Murray and Smith-Njigba: 36.61. ManicOrientals is 5‑6, one game out of sixth. This is the whole season sitting on a bench.

And then there's me. Parker Washington is out with a shoulder injury and he's in my lineup. Without him StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte projects to lose to the 0‑11 team by 8.74. With Devaughn Vele in his spot it's StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte by 0.91. That's the margin between me and being the first team Dude, Your Getting a Dell beats. I'll be fixing it. Probably.

stories.title: Mason Rudolph scored 11.68 on the Hold My DK bench, and it didn't matter because Hold My DK is 10‑1
stories.dek: TheMoneyTeam2302 picked up the right quarterback Wednesday and started the wrong one Thursday. Bo Nix scored 1.96.
body: TheMoneyTeam2302 added Mason Rudolph Wednesday morning, before anybody else figured out Pittsburgh was moving on from Aaron Rodgers. Smart. Then he started Patrick Mahomes, who scored 5.66 in the Buffalo rain, and Rudolph went 9 for 15 for 142 yards and a touchdown and scored 11.68 on the bench. That's 6.02 points left over, which is nothing when you lead by 26.74.

DK Metcalf caught the touchdown, 22 yards, and scored 11.1. Hold My DK still has Christian McCaffrey, Derrick Henry, Drake London, George Kittle and Chuba Hubbard going Sunday. The Champ has seven starters left, including Joe Burrow and Ashton Jeanty. My line is Hold My DK by 5.0, down from 13.0, because the remaining averages favor The Champ's guys more than the score suggests.

Bo Nix was the other story, and not in a good way for OBJAY. Two interceptions, a fumble T.J. Watt recovered for a touchdown, 169 yards on 40 attempts, 1.96 fantasy points. OBJAY still leads 36.26 to 15.90 because James Cook III scored 23.5 Thursday, and because Asian Jim keeps starting a quarterback without a team.

Waddle had five catches for 9.3 for Jefferson’s Reserve. Jonah Coleman scored 12.7 for Kraft for Cash. Rico Dowdle scored 7.9 for Bourbon Lover and Courtland Sutton 0.9. Rodgers is still on the Hold My DK roster, by the way, with no NFL team. TheMoneyTeam2302 doesn't have any picks in the first four rounds of the next three drafts, so I guess you keep everything.

stories.title: Six spots, three weeks, and the two teams at 6‑5 are both trailing
stories.dek: The Champ and Jefferson’s Reserve hold the last two spots. Asian Jim is one game back and benching its best receiver.
body: Here's the board through Week 11. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 10‑1, Catfan94’s Farm Team is 8‑3, Kraft for Cash is 7‑4. Then The Champ at 6‑5 with 1537.98 points and Jefferson’s Reserve at 6‑5 with 1380.50. Asian Jim is 5‑6. I Chase Brown Kids and OBJAY are 4‑7. Ties break on points for, and The Champ has a 157.48-point cushion on Jefferson’s Reserve.

This week: The Champ trails Hold My DK 48.96 to 22.22 with seven starters left; my line is Hold My DK by 5.0. Jefferson’s Reserve trails I Chase Brown Kids 33.30 to 10.40 with seven left; I Chase Brown Kids by 9.5. Asian Jim is a 3.0-point favorite over OBJAY even with Daniel Jones in the lineup, and a lot more than that if ManicOrientals swaps in Kyler Murray and Jaxon Smith-Njigba.

If Asian Jim wins and both 6‑5 teams lose, there's a three-way tie at 6‑6 with two weeks left, and Asian Jim has the fewest points of the three at 1273.92. Points matter. Every point Smith-Njigba scores on the bench is a point ManicOrientals doesn't get back in a tiebreaker.

I Chase Brown Kids at 4‑7 can still get there, but it needs to win out and get help. ZachCarroll09 has already left 31.5 from Blake Corum on the bench this week. Dynasty-wise, the 4‑7 teams are the ones who should be thinking about 2027. Nobody's selling yet.

stories.title: TJohn91 traded Kimani Vidal and a fourth for Isiah Pacheco, who's on IR, on Thanksgiving morning, during a playoff race
stories.dek: The Champ is 6‑5 and trailing Hold My DK. Catfan94 gets another running back, because of course he does.
body: The only trade of the week landed Thursday morning: TJohn91 sent Kimani Vidal and a 2027 fourth-round pick (originally Hold My DK's) to Catfan94 for Isiah Pacheco. Pacheco is on Detroit's IR after back surgery in September. The report at the time said about 12 weeks and an early-December return.

So here's the read. The Champ is 6‑5, holds the tiebreaker on Jefferson’s Reserve for the last spot, and Josh Jacobs and TreVeyon Henderson are both unavailable. TJohn91 is betting Pacheco is back for the fantasy playoffs. If he is, it's a two-time champ buying a running back for the part of the season that matters. If he isn't, it's a guy who traded a healthy 25-year-old for a roster spot with a red tag on it.

From the other side: Catfan94 is 10‑1 with 1860.84 points and now has Kimani Vidal on top of Gibbs, Barkley, Emmett Johnson, De'Von Achane, Rachaad White, Tank Bigsby and Ollie Gordon II. Nobody needed this less. He did it anyway, and picked up a fourth. That's how you get to 1860.

Dynasty angle: Pacheco is 27 and Vidal is 25. Both are backups on their real teams right now. The Champ is playing for this year, which is what you do when you've won the last two. Hold My DK, who already sold its 2027 picks through round four, is now watching its old fourth get passed around like a joint.

feature.title: Week 11: Kraft for Cash hangs 197.20, LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix holds off Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑11

Jonah Coleman 35.4, CeeDee Lamb 28.7, Travis Kelce 26.9, Justin Herbert 26.44, DJ Moore 21.6. OBJAY got 0.0 from Oronde Gadsden at tight end and 19.2 from Antonio Williams on the bench.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat I Chase Brown Kids 146.16 to 135.78. Jahmyr Gibbs 28.8 and Emmett Johnson 26.3 carried it; Ja'Marr Chase scored 5.6 on Monday and it was still enough. I Chase Brown Kids had the bad beat of the week with Rashod Bateman's 16.2 on the bench and Adonai Mitchell's 4.5 in the lineup.

Hold My DK beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 142.50 to 70.84 behind Patrick Mahomes (30.96) and Chuba Hubbard (29.0). Catfan94’s Farm Team beat Asian Jim 140.98 to 81.94 with Brock Purdy at 28.2. Jefferson’s Reserve beat Bourbon Lover 127.00 to 115.20 with C.J. Stroud at 26.96 while Dak Prescott scored 44.9 for the losing side again.
The Champ beat StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 123.26 to 73.20. Ashton Jeanty 27.9, Jared Goff 27.86, Joe Burrow 23.9. Bill_Buttlicker had Jacory Croskey-Merritt's 16.7 sitting in an IR slot and is 3‑8.

columnists.name: Hugh G. Rection
columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from a basement shrine to Boston sports in pajama pants, fueled by Dunkin'. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columnists.name: Richard "Dick" Gozinya
columnists.bio: Press-box regular with a pocket square and a former linebacker's bedside manner. Blunt, polished, and always one sentence away from calling you soft.

columnists.name: Holden McGroin
columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league once. Nobody knows how. Files his columns from the porch of a trailer with a laptop he calls 'the press credential' and gives advice anyway.

columnists.name: Ivana Humpalot
columnists.bio: Covers the league from the sideline with a media pass and a spreadsheet for everything. None of her spreadsheets are correct, and she will defend every one of them.

columns.title: JAXON SMITH-NJIGBA AVERAGES 25.22 AND HE'S ON THE BENCH!! AGAIN!!
columns.dek: Hugh G. Rection read the Asian Jim lineup and spilled an entire Dunkin' box.
body: TWENTY-FIVE POINT TWO TWO!! THAT'S HIS AVERAGE!! He scored 42.5 in Week 2! 33.86 in Week 3! 31.6 in Week 10! And he's sitting behind MALACHI FIELDS, who averages 6.35!! SIX!! I'VE SCORED SIX!! IN MY BASEMENT!!

Seattle took him OFF the injury report Friday. OFF! He's PLAYING! He's ON THE ASIAN JIM BENCH! And who's at quarterback? DANIEL JONES! WHO DOESN'T HAVE A TEAM! And who's on the bench? KYLER MURRAY! WHO DOES!

ManicOrientals is 5‑6, ONE GAME out of sixth place, and the swap math says Asian Jim goes from a 3-point favorite to a 36-POINT favorite. THIRTY-SIX!! You don't need a coach for that! You need a THUMB!

SET. YOUR. LINEUP. I swear on every banner in this basement, if Smith-Njigba scores 30 on that bench I'm driving to wherever ManicOrientals lives and setting it MYSELF!! (I won't. I don't know where he lives. But I'm YELLING about it!!)

columns.title: TJohn91 traded for a running back on IR in the middle of a playoff race. I respect it. I don't like it.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya on The Champ, Isiah Pacheco, and buying for December.
body: Two titles in two years buys you a little benefit of the doubt. TJohn91 sent Kimani Vidal and a 2027 fourth to Catfan94 for Isiah Pacheco on Thanksgiving morning. Pacheco is on Detroit's IR after back surgery in September. The report back then said about 12 weeks. You do that math and you land on the fantasy playoffs.

Here's my problem. The Champ is 6‑5 and holds the last spot on a tiebreaker. Josh Jacobs is out, TreVeyon Henderson is on IR, A.J. Brown is Doubtful. You don't get to December by acquiring a guy who can't play until December. You get there by winning this week, and right now you're down 37.86 to 22.22 to a 10‑1 team.

When I played, the coaches who won were the ones who planned for January without forgetting about Sunday. TJohn91 has done that twice. Maybe this is the third time. But if Jefferson’s Reserve jumps him on points, nobody's going to remember the plan.
And Catfan94, a fourth-round pick and a 25-year-old back for nothing you needed. You're 10‑1. That's not a trade, that's a tax. Pay attention, everybody else.

columns.title: 6 Saturday lineup moves from Holden McGroin, who already set his for Week 14
columns.dek: Holden McGroin's advice for Sunday, typed on the trailer porch with a space heater.
body: 1. BTaylor1, Justin Herbert is out and Bryce Young averages 21.21. Do nothing. Monday night is too late in the week to trust a guy. By Monday you're basically in Week 13.
2. ManicOrientals, keep Daniel Jones in there. A quarterback with no team has no bad matchups. That's just math.
3. TheMoneyTeam2302, you benched Mason Rudolph's 11.68 for Mahomes' 5.66. Next week, start Aaron Rodgers. Nobody will see it coming, including the defense, because he won't be there.

4. jrsmith1391, Joe Milton scored 38.74 on your bench. You're up 43.60. Put Milton in Sunday. Oh wait, he played Thursday. Okay, put him in next week, then bench him the week after. Keep 'em guessing.
5. ZachCarroll09, Blake Corum scored 31.5 on your bench. Bench Javonte Williams next week so they both know how it feels. Team chemistry.
6. Bill_Buttlicker, Parker Washington is out. Leave him in, so the 0‑11 team gets one win. It's the classy thing to do. That's what I'd do. That's why I finished 14th in a 12-team league.

columns.title: Mason Rudolph scored 15.9 times more per attempt than Bo Nix. My model says that makes him the MVP of Friday.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot divided fantasy points by pass attempts. Then she kept going.
body: Mason Rudolph threw 15 passes and scored 11.68. That's 0.78 points per attempt. Bo Nix threw 40 and scored 1.96, which is 0.049. Rudolph was 15.9 times more efficient, which my model extends over a full 40-attempt game to 31.1 points. Rudolph was on the Hold My DK bench. Nix was in the OBJAY lineup. My model has filed a complaint with both.

Nix averaged 4.2 yards per attempt. Rudolph averaged 9.5. If you add them together you get 13.7 yards per attempt, which is what I'm calling the 'Black Friday composite quarterback.' He's available on waivers. He's not real. I've added him anyway.

Here's the big one. Jaxon Smith-Njigba averages 25.22 and is on the Asian Jim bench. Malachi Fields averages 6.35 and is starting. That's a 3.97-to-1 ratio, which my model says should make Smith-Njigba 'four Malachi Fieldses.' Asian Jim only has one Malachi Fields. Mathematically, ManicOrientals is benching three Malachi Fieldses who don't exist. That's a lot of Fieldses.

And Dude, Your Getting a Dell is favored by 8.5 over StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte. Br0phy has a 0‑11 record, so my model gave him a 0.0% chance of being favored this season. It happened anyway. I'm not saying my model was wrong. I'm saying the season was.

exits.t: Has scored 162.9 points on the Jefferson’s Reserve bench this season, the most bench points of any player in the league, and started three times for 73.7. Still behind Trevor Lawrence and C.J. Stroud in a superflex lineup. Would like to be traded somewhere his points count.
Zero starts and 128.6 bench points for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix this season. Catfan94 just added Mac Jones, so he's now one of five quarterbacks on a roster that starts two.
Zero starts, 88.8 points on the I Chase Brown Kids bench this year. Watched Blake Corum score 31.5 on that same bench Wednesday and figured out where he stands.
Hasn't started a game for Hold My DK this season and has 99.0 bench points. George Kittle starts every week. Waller would like a team that has more than one tight end spot in its heart.
122.4 points on The Champ bench, 80.8 in four starts. Jared Goff starts at superflex. Stafford scored 2.6 on the bench Wednesday, which is the one week benching him was right.
66.6 points on my taxi squad this season and zero starts, while I've started four different tight ends. He's 21. He'd like to be on a team that sets its lineup. He's not alone.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025, and is 28-11 all time.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history, and his 232.54 in Week 10 is second. Nobody else has topped 198.64.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the third-lowest score in league history, and is 10-29 all time.
Br0phy's 39.26 in Week 8 this year is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0-11.
